g.text: Log-linear forwards are a step function:

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 9px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: they jump 90bp at this node and are flat between.

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 9px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: Monotone convex is continuous through it.

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 600 15px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: All three schemes reprice the market exactly, and disagree about forwards

text.style: fill: #6b6b6b; font: 11px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Instantaneous forwards from the same 13 CMT quotes, 2025-12-31 · worst repricing residual across all three: 1.8e-11 bp

text.style: fill: #6b6b6b; font: italic 8px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: US Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve Rates (CMT), as of 2025-12-31. Computed by fi_report from data/treasury_par_yields_2025.csv. Scheme per Hagan & West (2006), Applied Mathematical Finance 13(2), 89-129.
